title: fix(cli): acknowledge reports inside Claude paste wrappers
body:
Code changes: +27 -2\
Tests: +116 -6\
Others: +0 -0

## What

Restore correlated acceptance of report deliveries when Claude Code wraps pasted input. Add regressions for the prompt shapes seen in the replay investigation.

## Why

Claude Code's leading `<pasted_content id="eead">` wrapper hides the `<ao-report-delivery>` envelope from the strict hook parsers. The hook records human origin without the delivery ID. Semantic acceptance then times out, the coordinator releases the claim, and the same stuck-report batch returns about every three minutes.

The open and closed issue/PR audit found no existing fix for this wrapper bug. The old Untrivial-ai repository redirects to OrchestratorInc. Main at `6942e179517f23c490d6ef0bbbc0d96c99408426` still reproduces it. Related #6119 concerns Qwen batch starvation and has a different cause.

Local evidence pointer: `/Users/dev/.ao/data/artifacts/ao-agentic-testing-23/report-replay-rootcause.md`, investigated baseline `70813e6687dd9870e79b1a772961f65a893c8686`. The tests retain paste boundaries from native transcript lines 1538, 687, 659, and 1303, with unrelated report text shortened.

## How

- Normalize only a known leading Claude paste wrapper before authorship and delivery-ID parsing. Require its closing tag and preserve text after the pasted segment, including the rest of a split report envelope.
- Keep the raw prompt for human checkpoints. Human text before the report still prevents classification as coordination.
- Preserve main's `CoordinationDeliveryID` path and leave `ReportDeliveryID` strict. Test malformed wrappers, invalid IDs, mixed human prompts, and another agent.

Terminated-worker filtering, acceptance receipts, and coordinator retry policy remain outside this fix.

## Testing

Passed locally with AO sess
